parties.name: Liberal Democratic Party
parties.description: Market liberal; classical liberal and national liberal factions. Strong defence and national sovereignty.

parties.name: Civic Alliance
parties.description: Centrist and moderately pro-market. Families, public services, social cohesion and work-linked welfare.

parties.name: Social Democratic Party
parties.description: Social democracy, stronger labour institutions, redistribution and expanded public services.

parties.name: Conservative Party
parties.description: Social conservatism, religious school choice, rural communities, farmers and fishermen.

parties.name: Green Party
parties.description: Cosmopolitan green liberalism, low-carbon energy, civil liberties and international cooperation.

parties.name: National Front
parties.description: National conservatism, immigration restriction, protectionism and fewer overseas commitments.

parties.name: Libertarian Party
parties.description: Private property, personal freedom, fiscal restraint and a substantially smaller state.

parties.name: United Progressive Left
parties.description: Democratic socialism, redistribution, social liberalism and Violetist minority interests.

parties.name: Socialist Workers Party
parties.description: Communism and a fundamental transformation of economic ownership and political institutions.
